Model questions

MPT5TN FAQ

What is the rated capacity of the MPT5TN?

The stated rated capacity is 5,000 kg. Final suitability depends on load center, lift height, attachment, and operating conditions.

What is the lift specification of the MPT5TN?

The listed lift specification is 85-185 mm fork height. Confirm the required maximum height and residual capacity before ordering.

What information is needed to quote the MPT5TN?

Provide load weight and dimensions, lift height, aisle or route conditions, daily duty, battery requirement, quantity, and destination.
